 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

[原文]
 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.

**一、作者的归因：WRV 为何上升**
作者报道，打浆度和 WRV 随 PFI 转数的增加而显著升高（见 Figure 2）[2]。对此，作者把 WRV 上升归因于：打浆使细纤维化程度提高，产生了**新的表面和更多孔隙**（作者将其与 Online Resource 表 S1 的比表面积/孔隙数据相对应）[2]；也就是说，外部细纤维化随打浆增强，这与比表面积增大相一致[2]。需要注意的是，没有对 Figure 2 做像素级读图，因此这里只引用作者的趋势性陈述，不给出具体数值。

**二、与纤维间结合的联系**
作者的解释是：由 WRV 表征的润胀增加会使纤维在**横向更柔顺**，从而**有助于**改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度，原文用 "contributes to" 表明这是贡献关系而非唯一决定因素[2]。作者还将干抗张强度的提升主要归因于 PFI 打浆过程中的细纤维化和细小组分[2]；其中，细小组分含量上升是作者针对**针叶浆**明确报告的（对于阔叶浆，该段落未作同样的报告）[2]。

**三、氢键层面的补充（作者的解释性机制）**
作者报告，分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键总量在打浆全程分别下降 16.54%（针叶浆）与 5.91%（阔叶浆），并将其归因于 PFI 机械作用下的纤维素分子链断裂，这与内、外部细纤维化密切相关；作者同时指出，既有断裂也有新氢键形成[4]。作者认为，分子间氢键减少与结晶度降低会通过分子链活动性、可及性和 WRV 的提高，使纤维素纤维更柔顺[4]。游离 OH(2)/OH(6) 因不稳定而易于重新形成 O(2)H···O(6) 或 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键，因此干燥时这两类氢键含量"可能"增加——这是带有推测语气的表述[4]。
另一项限定：作者指出，PFI 打浆并未改变三类氢键的键能与键长，因为峰位基本未发生红移或蓝移[6]。

**四、条件、方法学与证据缺口**
- 样品为针叶浆与阔叶浆两类；作者对阔叶浆形态参数（宏观细纤维化指数、纤维长度）的变化不显著，并推测这与所用的较低打浆压力有关[2]。因此，上述形态学、细小组分的结论不能无差别外推到阔叶浆。
- WRV 按 ISO 23714 用 0.5 g 绝干样品测定，定义为 (m₁−m₂)/m₂×100%[3][5]。
- 证据缺口：文中给出的是打浆度、WRV 与强度指标同向变化的观测，加上机理解释，并未提供"WRV 上升→结合强度提高"的直接因果实验（如控制 WRV 的分离实验）；"干燥时氢键重新形成"在原文中即为推测性表述[2][4]。

basis.text: The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. It is caused by the higher fibrillation that produces the new surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process.

reference.question: 按照作者的解释，PFI打浆为什么会提高WRV，又如何与纤维间结合联系起来？
reference.reference_answer: 打浆促进细纤维化，产生新的表面和更多孔隙，使WRV及纤维膨胀提高；纤维横向更柔顺，有助于改善纤维网络中的纤维间结合。这是本文提出的解释链条，不能据此给出每一步的独立因果效应大小。

candidate.answer:
**不一样。但严格来说，现有证据只能说明：在这组 PFI 打浆条件下，针叶木与阔叶木的纤维长度变化幅度和显著性不同；这不足以证明差别来自树种固有差异。**

Li 等使用商品漂白针叶木和阔叶木硫酸盐浆，在 PFI 磨中打浆；浆浓为 10%，磨盘间隙为 0.2 mm；针叶木与阔叶木对应的每齿长作用力分别为 3.33 N/mm 和 1.77 N/mm；两者都在 0、4,000、8,000、12,000、16,000 转下处理[2]。在 Figure 1 中，横轴为 PFI 打浆转数，纵轴为长度加权平均纤维长度（µm）：针叶木的该指标从约 2,000 µm 降至约 1,650 µm；阔叶木则在约 900 µm 附近仅小幅波动[8]。原文也概括两者纤维长度均呈下降趋势，但明确指出针叶木的巨纤丝化指数和纤维长度变化显著，而阔叶木这两个参数的变化相对针叶木不显著[1]。需要注意的是，图中未见误差棒，上述长度数值是看图得到的近似值，原文未给出该指标的统计量。

对于差别的可能原因，作者提出：这可能是因为阔叶木打浆时施加的压力较低[1]；方法部分也显示，阔叶木的每齿长作用力约为针叶木的一半[2]。因此，观察到的差异混杂了加载条件与原料差异：不能据此判断哪种木材更易被切断，也不能证明差异由细胞壁结构等树种固有因素造成。

**尚未解决的证据缺口：**所检索文献没有提供细胞壁厚度、微纤丝角、纤维粗度等内在结构导致两者切断差异的直接数据，也没有在等打浆强度条件下进行比较；并且证据仅来自单篇 PFI 研究，不能直接外推到其他打浆方式。

[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions
[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

sources.text:
[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

claims.text:
**不一样。但严格来说，现有证据只能说明：在这组 PFI 打浆条件下，针叶木与阔叶木的纤维长度变化幅度和显著性不同；这不足以证明差别来自树种固有差异。**

Li 等使用商品漂白针叶木和阔叶木硫酸盐浆，在 PFI 磨中打浆；浆浓为 10%，磨盘间隙为 0.2 mm；针叶木与阔叶木对应的每齿长作用力分别为 3.33 N/mm 和 1.77 N/mm；两者都在 0、4,000、8,000、12,000、16,000 转下处理[2]。在 Figure 1 中，横轴为 PFI 打浆转数，纵轴为长度加权平均纤维长度（µm）：针叶木的该指标从约 2,000 µm 降至约 1,650 µm；阔叶木则在约 900 µm 附近仅小幅波动[8]。原文也概括两者纤维长度均呈下降趋势，但明确指出针叶木的巨纤丝化指数和纤维长度变化显著，而阔叶木这两个参数的变化相对针叶木不显著[1]。需要注意的是，图中未见误差棒，上述长度数值是看图得到的近似值，原文未给出该指标的统计量。
对于差别的可能原因，作者提出：这可能是因为阔叶木打浆时施加的压力较低[1]；方法部分也显示，阔叶木的每齿长作用力约为针叶木的一半[2]。因此，观察到的差异混杂了加载条件与原料差异：不能据此判断哪种木材更易被切断，也不能证明差异由细胞壁结构等树种固有因素造成。
**尚未解决的证据缺口：**所检索文献没有提供细胞壁厚度、微纤丝角、纤维粗度等内在结构导致两者切断差异的直接数据，也没有在等打浆强度条件下进行比较；并且证据仅来自单篇 PFI 研究，不能直接外推到其他打浆方式。

basis.text: For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource).

candidate.answer:
**结论：本文把“纸页抗张强度”和“纤维抗张强度”当作两个不同层级的指标：前者是纤维网络的性能，后者才涉及单根纤维本体。**

**1. 纸页抗张强度提高，主要归因于纤维间结合，并非纤维本体变强**
- 作者明确写道：抗张强度的增量“主要归因于 PFI 磨浆过程中的细纤维化和细小纤维”［13］。同时，磨浆使纤维润湿膨胀（WRV 升高），作者认为横向更柔顺的纤维“有助于”改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度［10］；而 WRV 与打浆度的升高被认为源于细纤维化产生的新表面与更多孔隙［9］。引言也把 PFI 磨浆列为主要提高 inter-fiber bonding capacity 与可及性的手段，并列出内细纤维化、外细纤维化、纤维切断和细小纤维生成四种作用［21］。
- 即：纸页是纤维网络，其抗张强度取决于结合面积与结合强度、纤维柔顺性、长度分布与网络均匀性等，不等同于任何单根纤维的轴向强度。需注意原文用的是“contributes to（有助于）”，并非定量因果证明［10］。

**2. 为什么“纸张抗张提高”不意味着“单纤维强度也提高”**
- 文中用零距抗张来表征纤维本身的抗张强度：“The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers”；结果是 **PFI 磨浆“没有降低”纤维强度**，与 Kouko 等的报道一致［15］。
- 该节总结的措辞同样是：磨浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内细纤维化）、纤维润湿膨胀和**纸页**抗张强度，而**纤维**抗张强度没有下降（without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers）［16］。因此，作者的结论是“未被削弱”，并不是“被提高”；纸页强度上升不能归因于单纤维变强。
- 图 3 的趋势与之一致：在软木（a）与硬木（b）两组中，普通抗张指数（红色，N·m/g）随磨浆转数上升的幅度，都明显大于零距抗张指数（蓝色，N·m/g）的上升幅度；例如软木组红色曲线约由 10 升至 85 N·m/g，蓝色曲线约由 100 升至 180 N·m/g，硬木组红色约由 10 升至 75 N·m/g，蓝色约由 150 升至 205 N·m/g（此为按坐标轴目测的近似值，未做数值读取；红、蓝使用不同纵轴）。普通抗张与零距抗张的增幅不成比例，说明纸页增强主要来自网络结合层面的变化［19］［17］。
- 形态条件需限定：磨浆过程中纤维长度下降、细小纤维含量上升，这一趋势在**软木浆**中显著；**硬木浆**的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度**无显著变化**，作者推测与硬木所用磨浆压力较低有关［6］。因此，形态变化对纸页网络的影响不能无条件外推到两种浆料。此外，纤维长度下降本身也会改变纸页网络性能，但同样不等于单纤维强度提高。

**3. 零距抗张在这里的作用**
- **分离“结合贡献”与“纤维本体贡献”：** 本文只说明零距抗张“通常用于表征纤维抗张强度”［15］，并未在文中展开其力学原理；按其逻辑，零距抗张可与普通抗张形成对照：普通抗张大幅上升、零距抗张变化幅度明显更小且未下降时，增强应归因于纤维间结合，而不是纤维本身变强［15］［16］［19］。（“零距下纤维搭接/结合作用被抑制”属通用机理说明，本文未作解释。）
- **检验磨浆是否损伤纤维：** 打浆伴随切断与细纤维化，理论上可能削弱纤维；本文用零距抗张结果说明 PFI 磨浆未降低纤维强度，从而支持“纸页增强不是以牺牲纤维强度为代价”的解释［15］［16］。
- 方法上，干纸页抗张按 TAPPI T494 测试；零距抗张按 ISO 15361，用 Pulmac Z-Span 2400 测定［2］。图 3 中蓝色指标被标为“fiber strength”，红色为干纸页抗张指数，黑色为湿纸幅抗张指数［17］。

**未解决的证据缺口**
- 本文**未做单根纤维拉伸试验**；零距抗张是间接指标，可能受纤维长度分布、细小纤维与网络因素影响，文中未讨论这些局限，也未给出普通抗张/零距抗张的统计显著性检验（图 3 中虽有误差棒，但未报告显著性判定）［19］。
- 因此，“纸页抗张提高 ≠ 单纤维强度提高”在本文中是由“普通抗张明显上升，同时零距抗张未下降、增幅明显较小”的对照所作的推断，而不是对单根纤维强度的直接测量证明。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds [原文] On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(30) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(30) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1). [章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34]. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds [原文] In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

claims.text:
**结论：本文把“纸页抗张强度”和“纤维抗张强度”当作两个不同层级的指标：前者是纤维网络的性能，后者才涉及单根纤维本体。**

**1. 纸页抗张强度提高，主要归因于纤维间结合，并非纤维本体变强**
- 作者明确写道：抗张强度的增量“主要归因于 PFI 磨浆过程中的细纤维化和细小纤维”［13］。同时，磨浆使纤维润湿膨胀（WRV 升高），作者认为横向更柔顺的纤维“有助于”改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度［10］；而 WRV 与打浆度的升高被认为源于细纤维化产生的新表面与更多孔隙［9］。引言也把 PFI 磨浆列为主要提高 inter-fiber bonding capacity 与可及性的手段，并列出内细纤维化、外细纤维化、纤维切断和细小纤维生成四种作用［21］。
- 即：纸页是纤维网络，其抗张强度取决于结合面积与结合强度、纤维柔顺性、长度分布与网络均匀性等，不等同于任何单根纤维的轴向强度。需注意原文用的是“contributes to（有助于）”，并非定量因果证明［10］。

**2. 为什么“纸张抗张提高”不意味着“单纤维强度也提高”**
- 文中用零距抗张来表征纤维本身的抗张强度：“The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers”；结果是 **PFI 磨浆“没有降低”纤维强度**，与 Kouko 等的报道一致［15］。
- 该节总结的措辞同样是：磨浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内细纤维化）、纤维润湿膨胀和**纸页**抗张强度，而**纤维**抗张强度没有下降（without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers）［16］。因此，作者的结论是“未被削弱”，并不是“被提高”；纸页强度上升不能归因于单纤维变强。
- 图 3 的趋势与之一致：在软木（a）与硬木（b）两组中，普通抗张指数（红色，N·m/g）随磨浆转数上升的幅度，都明显大于零距抗张指数（蓝色，N·m/g）的上升幅度；例如软木组红色曲线约由 10 升至 85 N·m/g，蓝色曲线约由 100 升至 180 N·m/g，硬木组红色约由 10 升至 75 N·m/g，蓝色约由 150 升至 205 N·m/g（此为按坐标轴目测的近似值，未做数值读取；红、蓝使用不同纵轴）。普通抗张与零距抗张的增幅不成比例，说明纸页增强主要来自网络结合层面的变化［19］［17］。
- 形态条件需限定：磨浆过程中纤维长度下降、细小纤维含量上升，这一趋势在**软木浆**中显著；**硬木浆**的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度**无显著变化**，作者推测与硬木所用磨浆压力较低有关［6］。因此，形态变化对纸页网络的影响不能无条件外推到两种浆料。此外，纤维长度下降本身也会改变纸页网络性能，但同样不等于单纤维强度提高。

**3. 零距抗张在这里的作用**
- **分离“结合贡献”与“纤维本体贡献”：** 本文只说明零距抗张“通常用于表征纤维抗张强度”［15］，并未在文中展开其力学原理；按其逻辑，零距抗张可与普通抗张形成对照：普通抗张大幅上升、零距抗张变化幅度明显更小且未下降时，增强应归因于纤维间结合，而不是纤维本身变强［15］［16］［19］。（“零距下纤维搭接/结合作用被抑制”属通用机理说明，本文未作解释。）
- **检验磨浆是否损伤纤维：** 打浆伴随切断与细纤维化，理论上可能削弱纤维；本文用零距抗张结果说明 PFI 磨浆未降低纤维强度，从而支持“纸页增强不是以牺牲纤维强度为代价”的解释［15］［16］。
- 方法上，干纸页抗张按 TAPPI T494 测试；零距抗张按 ISO 15361，用 Pulmac Z-Span 2400 测定［2］。图 3 中蓝色指标被标为“fiber strength”，红色为干纸页抗张指数，黑色为湿纸幅抗张指数［17］。

**未解决的证据缺口**
- 本文**未做单根纤维拉伸试验**；零距抗张是间接指标，可能受纤维长度分布、细小纤维与网络因素影响，文中未讨论这些局限，也未给出普通抗张/零距抗张的统计显著性检验（图 3 中虽有误差棒，但未报告显著性判定）［19］。
- 因此，“纸页抗张提高 ≠ 单纤维强度提高”在本文中是由“普通抗张明显上升，同时零距抗张未下降、增幅明显较小”的对照所作的推断，而不是对单根纤维强度的直接测量证明。

basis.text: In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.

The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.

claim_assessments.text:
**2. 为什么“纸张抗张提高”不意味着“单纤维强度也提高”**
- 文中用零距抗张来表征纤维本身的抗张强度：“The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers”；结果是 **PFI 磨浆“没有降低”纤维强度**，与 Kouko 等的报道一致［15］。
- 该节总结的措辞同样是：磨浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内细纤维化）、纤维润湿膨胀和**纸页**抗张强度，而**纤维**抗张强度没有下降（without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers）［16］。因此，作者的结论是“未被削弱”，并不是“被提高”；纸页强度上升不能归因于单纤维变强。
- 图 3 的趋势与之一致：在软木（a）与硬木（b）两组中，普通抗张指数（红色，N·m/g）随磨浆转数上升的幅度，都明显大于零距抗张指数（蓝色，N·m/g）的上升幅度；例如软木组红色曲线约由 10 升至 85 N·m/g，蓝色曲线约由 100 升至 180 N·m/g，硬木组红色约由 10 升至 75 N·m/g，蓝色约由 150 升至 205 N·m/g（此为按坐标轴目测的近似值，未做数值读取；红、蓝使用不同纵轴）。普通抗张与零距抗张的增幅不成比例，说明纸页增强主要来自网络结合层面的变化［19］［17］。
- 形态条件需限定：磨浆过程中纤维长度下降、细小纤维含量上升，这一趋势在**软木浆**中显著；**硬木浆**的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度**无显著变化**，作者推测与硬木所用磨浆压力较低有关［6］。因此，形态变化对纸页网络的影响不能无条件外推到两种浆料。此外，纤维长度下降本身也会改变纸页网络性能，但同样不等于单纤维强度提高。

claim_assessments.text:
**3. 零距抗张在这里的作用**
- **分离“结合贡献”与“纤维本体贡献”：** 本文只说明零距抗张“通常用于表征纤维抗张强度”［15］，并未在文中展开其力学原理；按其逻辑，零距抗张可与普通抗张形成对照：普通抗张大幅上升、零距抗张变化幅度明显更小且未下降时，增强应归因于纤维间结合，而不是纤维本身变强［15］［16］［19］。（“零距下纤维搭接/结合作用被抑制”属通用机理说明，本文未作解释。）
- **检验磨浆是否损伤纤维：** 打浆伴随切断与细纤维化，理论上可能削弱纤维；本文用零距抗张结果说明 PFI 磨浆未降低纤维强度，从而支持“纸页增强不是以牺牲纤维强度为代价”的解释［15］［16］。
- 方法上，干纸页抗张按 TAPPI T494 测试；零距抗张按 ISO 15361，用 Pulmac Z-Span 2400 测定［2］。图 3 中蓝色指标被标为“fiber strength”，红色为干纸页抗张指数，黑色为湿纸幅抗张指数［17］。

claim_assessments.text:
**未解决的证据缺口**
- 本文**未做单根纤维拉伸试验**；零距抗张是间接指标，可能受纤维长度分布、细小纤维与网络因素影响，文中未讨论这些局限，也未给出普通抗张/零距抗张的统计显著性检验（图 3 中虽有误差棒，但未报告显著性判定）［19］。
- 因此，“纸页抗张提高 ≠ 单纤维强度提高”在本文中是由“普通抗张明显上升，同时零距抗张未下降、增幅明显较小”的对照所作的推断，而不是对单根纤维强度的直接测量证明。

reference.question: 为什么本文认为纸张抗张性能提高，并不意味着单根纤维本身的强度也一定提高？零距抗张在这里有什么用？
reference.reference_answer: 作者将纸张抗张性能改善主要联系到细纤维化、细小纤维及纤维间结合。零距抗张指数用于表征纤维本身的抗张强度，结果表明本文PFI处理没有降低纤维强度。因此应区分纸页网络性能和纤维本身强度，不能只凭纸张变强推断单根纤维必然变强。

adjudication.summary: 简短两句完整必答，作者湿强长度解释支持。

candidate.answer: 在本文的 PFI 磨浆实验中，针叶木浆的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木浆更明显[1]。作者对此的解释是：纤维长度在湿纸幅强度中起关键作用，因此较长的针叶木纤维使湿纸幅强度提升更显著[1]。

As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.

basis.text: In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. ## 更正后的答案

该论文（Li et al., 2020）所称 FT-IR 氢键“相对含量”，是**去卷积子峰的相对面积百分比**，属于半定量结果，不等同于绝对摩尔分数或绝对氢键数量。

**1. 样品与光谱条件**
- 样品为软木和硬木纸浆纤维，包括未打浆及 PFI 打浆至 4000、8000、12000、16000 r 的样品[2]。
- 纤维粉碎至 40–60 目；5 mg 样品分散于 500 mg 高纯 KBr 中压片；透射模式；4000–400 cm⁻¹；分辨率 4 cm⁻¹；64 次扫描；结果取 5 次记录的平均谱[1]。

**2. 定峰与拟合**
- 光谱先在 **1016 cm⁻¹ 归一化**，再用 **Savitzky–Golay 算法**求二阶导数谱；各氢键组分的峰位根据二阶导数谱在相应归属区间读取[1]。
- 定量拟合区间为 **3000–3700 cm⁻¹** 的羟基伸缩振动带；在 **Peakfit 4.12** 中做**非线性拟合**，峰型函数为 **Gaussian（高斯）函数**[1]。
- 该带被解卷积为 **4 个主要子峰**：3 个氢键子峰 + 1 个自由 OH(2)/OH(6) 合并子峰[2]。

**3. 四个子峰的归属**
- 自由 OH(2) 与 OH(6)：3580–3550 cm⁻¹[6]。
- O(2)H···O(6) 分子内氢键：3455–3410 cm⁻¹，峰位约 3452 cm⁻¹[6][2]。
- O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键：3375–3340 cm⁻¹，峰位约 3346 cm⁻¹[6][2]。
- O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键：3310–3230 cm⁻¹，峰位约 3227 cm⁻¹[6][2]。

**4. 含量口径**
- 作者明确说明：不同氢键的相对含量按各子峰的 **area proportion（面积占比）** 计算[2]。
- 即在同一 3000–3700 cm⁻¹ 拟合带内，以每个子峰面积除以四个子峰总面积得到百分比。表 2 的四列数值逐行合计为 100.00%（据表 2 数值计算）[2]。
- 因此该“含量”是**同一谱带内各氢键类型的相对面积比例**，不是吸收系数标定后的绝对浓度，也不能直接当作氢键的绝对数量。文中未给出面积百分比与摩尔分数之间的换算。

**5. 拟合质量与不确定性**
- 表 2 报告 **r² = 0.9989–0.9996**：软木为 0.9995–0.9996，硬木为 0.9989–0.9992[2]。
- 但所给表 2 中未见子峰面积的误差棒、置信区间或重复拟合的离散度；5 次记录平均只说明光谱获取方式，不能直接视为面积百分比的不确定度[1][2]。因此对百分数的细小差异应谨慎解读。

**6. 需更正的两点**
- 草稿把自由羟基写成“1 个自由羟基”，不准确；应为 **OH(2) 与 OH(6) 的合并子峰**，因此仍是 4 个子峰，但其中 3 个为氢键、1 个为自由 OH 合并峰[2]。
- 草稿中的 \(E_H=(\nu_0-\nu)/\nu_0\) 不宜直接复述：所给文本中式(4)的 OCR 显示不完整，且同段还定义了常数 \(k\)[1][4]。可保留的结论是：作者用峰位按式(4)、式(5)估算氢键能与氢键距离（式(4)参考自由 OH 3650 cm⁻¹，式(5)参考单体 OH 3600 cm⁻¹），并因三个氢键峰位几乎不变而判断其基本不变[1][2]。

**图像限制**：图 6、图 7 仅依据题注和正文引用，未查看图像像素，因此不对分峰曲线形态、基线或拟合残差作视觉判断；图 7 题注显示为软木 5 个打浆转数的去卷积谱，硬木结果见 Figure S3[2][5]。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.

In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. [原文]
As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.

claims.text:
## 更正后的答案

该论文（Li et al., 2020）所称 FT-IR 氢键“相对含量”，是**去卷积子峰的相对面积百分比**，属于半定量结果，不等同于绝对摩尔分数或绝对氢键数量。

**1. 样品与光谱条件**
- 样品为软木和硬木纸浆纤维，包括未打浆及 PFI 打浆至 4000、8000、12000、16000 r 的样品[2]。
- 纤维粉碎至 40–60 目；5 mg 样品分散于 500 mg 高纯 KBr 中压片；透射模式；4000–400 cm⁻¹；分辨率 4 cm⁻¹；64 次扫描；结果取 5 次记录的平均谱[1]。

**2. 定峰与拟合**
- 光谱先在 **1016 cm⁻¹ 归一化**，再用 **Savitzky–Golay 算法**求二阶导数谱；各氢键组分的峰位根据二阶导数谱在相应归属区间读取[1]。
- 定量拟合区间为 **3000–3700 cm⁻¹** 的羟基伸缩振动带；在 **Peakfit 4.12** 中做**非线性拟合**，峰型函数为 **Gaussian（高斯）函数**[1]。
- 该带被解卷积为 **4 个主要子峰**：3 个氢键子峰 + 1 个自由 OH(2)/OH(6) 合并子峰[2]。

**4. 含量口径**
- 作者明确说明：不同氢键的相对含量按各子峰的 **area proportion（面积占比）** 计算[2]。
- 即在同一 3000–3700 cm⁻¹ 拟合带内，以每个子峰面积除以四个子峰总面积得到百分比。表 2 的四列数值逐行合计为 100.00%（据表 2 数值计算）[2]。
- 因此该“含量”是**同一谱带内各氢键类型的相对面积比例**，不是吸收系数标定后的绝对浓度，也不能直接当作氢键的绝对数量。文中未给出面积百分比与摩尔分数之间的换算。

**5. 拟合质量与不确定性**
- 表 2 报告 **r² = 0.9989–0.9996**：软木为 0.9995–0.9996，硬木为 0.9989–0.9992[2]。
- 但所给表 2 中未见子峰面积的误差棒、置信区间或重复拟合的离散度；5 次记录平均只说明光谱获取方式，不能直接视为面积百分比的不确定度[1][2]。因此对百分数的细小差异应谨慎解读。

**6. 需更正的两点**
- 草稿把自由羟基写成“1 个自由羟基”，不准确；应为 **OH(2) 与 OH(6) 的合并子峰**，因此仍是 4 个子峰，但其中 3 个为氢键、1 个为自由 OH 合并峰[2]。
- 草稿中的 \(E_H=(
u_0-

**这三种氢键在 FT-IR 羟基区（3000–3700 cm⁻¹）的归属大概如下**（数值来自对二次导数谱做分峰拟合后的结果，测试样品为针叶木/阔叶木浆纤维）：

| 氢键 | 波数范围 | 拟合峰位（约） |
|---|---|---|
| O(6)H···O(3′) | 3310–3230 cm⁻¹ | ≈3227 cm⁻¹ |
| O(3)H···O(5) | 3375–3340 cm⁻¹ | ≈3346 cm⁻¹ |
| O(2)H···O(6) | 3455–3410 cm⁻¹ | ≈3452 cm⁻¹ |

作为对照，游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 归属于 3580–3550 cm⁻¹[2]。原文把 O(6)H···O(3′) 归为“分子间”氢键，而把 O(3)H···O(5)、O(2)H···O(6) 归为分子内氢键[2]；这些峰位在 PFI 磨浆过程中基本保持不变，也就是说，没有出现明显的红移或蓝移[3]。

需注意：上述数值是该文献的分峰赋值结果（引用文献[31,32]），不同样品、结晶度与测试条件会使峰位略有偏移；文中给出的三个“约”值基本落在相应范围的上/下端，个别值（如 3452 cm⁻¹）略微超出所列区间，属拟合与赋值误差范围内。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

**这三种氢键在 FT-IR 羟基区（3000–3700 cm⁻¹）的归属大概如下**（数值来自对二次导数谱做分峰拟合后的结果，测试样品为针叶木/阔叶木浆纤维）：

| 氢键 | 波数范围 | 拟合峰位（约） |
|---|---|---|
| O(6)H···O(3′) | 3310–3230 cm⁻¹ | ≈3227 cm⁻¹ |
| O(3)H···O(5) | 3375–3340 cm⁻¹ | ≈3346 cm⁻¹ |
| O(2)H···O(6) | 3455–3410 cm⁻¹ | ≈3452 cm⁻¹ |
作为对照，游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 归属于 3580–3550 cm⁻¹[2]。原文把 O(6)H···O(3′) 归为“分子间”氢键，而把 O(3)H···O(5)、O(2)H···O(6) 归为分子内氢键[2]；这些峰位在 PFI 磨浆过程中基本保持不变，也就是说，没有出现明显的红移或蓝移[3]。

candidate.answer:
不能这样推论。“氢键能量和距离基本不变”只表明：在该研究的 FT-IR 峰位分析中，三类氢键的峰位几乎不红移或蓝移，由峰位经公式推算的氢键能量和距离基本不变；这并不等于氢键网络的相对含量和组成没有变化。

论文确实据此指出，PFI 打浆没有改变氢键能量和氢键距离，就像没有改变纤维素晶型一样[1]。但摘要同时明确区分：晶型、氢键距离和氢键能量“几乎不变”，而结晶度、微晶尺寸以及各类氢键的含量随打浆发生变化[2]。因此，“能量和距离不变”不能外推为“氢键网络整体无影响”。

以软木浆 PFI 打浆 0→16,000 r 的 FT-IR 分峰**相对含量**为例（Table 2a）：

- O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键：28.23%→23.56%，作者报告总体下降 16.54%；
- O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键：28.44%→34.92%，总体上升 22.78%；
- O(2)H···O(6) 分子内氢键：31.40%→29.38%，总体下降；
- 游离 OH(2)、OH(6)：11.93%→12.14%，总体略升[4]。

这些是终点比较，过程中并非单调变化。硬木浆也呈现同类总体趋势，例如 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量总体下降 5.91%，O(3)H···O(5) 含量总体上升 8.8%[1]。

作者对机制的解释应保留其不确定性：O(6)H···O(3′) 的减少**可能**与 PFI 机械作用造成纤维素分子链断裂有关；过程中既有氢键断裂，也有新氢键形成；游离 OH 的增加则被解释为氢键断裂导致更充分分层和比表面积增加[1][4]。这些是解释性判断，不是已证实的唯一因果机制。

更准确的表述是：在该研究的 FT-IR 推断范围内，PFI 打浆基本不改变三类氢键的能量和距离，但会改变各类氢键的相对含量和比例；同时结晶度、微晶尺寸等也发生变化[1][2]。论文报告 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量与结晶度显著相关（软木浆 r=0.888，硬木浆 r=0.889，p<0.05），但这是相关性，不能据此断定打浆通过改变氢键网络而因果性地改变结晶度或纤维性能[2]。FT-IR 在此是氢键网络的间接表征手段，能量和距离也是由峰位推算的[1][3]。

因此，若“影响”指单种氢键的能量和距离，可以说基本不变；若指氢键网络的含量和类型比例，则打浆确有影响，不能说“整体基本没影响”。

Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction

Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

[原文]
Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. claims.text: 不能这样推论。“氢键能量和距离基本不变”只表明：在该研究的 FT-IR 峰位分析中，三类氢键的峰位几乎不红移或蓝移，由峰位经公式推算的氢键能量和距离基本不变；这并不等于氢键网络的相对含量和组成没有变化。
论文确实据此指出，PFI 打浆没有改变氢键能量和氢键距离，就像没有改变纤维素晶型一样[1]。但摘要同时明确区分：晶型、氢键距离和氢键能量“几乎不变”，而结晶度、微晶尺寸以及各类氢键的含量随打浆发生变化[2]。因此，“能量和距离不变”不能外推为“氢键网络整体无影响”。
这些是终点比较，过程中并非单调变化。硬木浆也呈现同类总体趋势，例如 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量总体下降 5.91%，O(3)H···O(5) 含量总体上升 8.8%[1]。
作者对机制的解释应保留其不确定性：O(6)H···O(3′) 的减少**可能**与 PFI 机械作用造成纤维素分子链断裂有关；过程中既有氢键断裂，也有新氢键形成；游离 OH 的增加则被解释为氢键断裂导致更充分分层和比表面积增加[1][4]。这些是解释性判断，不是已证实的唯一因果机制。

更准确的表述是：在该研究的 FT-IR 推断范围内，PFI 打浆基本不改变三类氢键的能量和距离，但会改变各类氢键的相对含量和比例；同时结晶度、微晶尺寸等也发生变化[1][2]。论文报告 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量与结晶度显著相关（软木浆 r=0.888，硬木浆 r=0.889，p<0.05），但这是相关性，不能据此断定打浆通过改变氢键网络而因果性地改变结晶度或纤维性能[2]。FT-IR 在此是氢键网络的间接表征手段，能量和距离也是由峰位推算的[1][3]。
因此，若“影响”指单种氢键的能量和距离，可以说基本不变；若指氢键网络的含量和类型比例，则打浆确有影响，不能说“整体基本没影响”。

reference.question: 论文说打浆后氢键能量和距离基本不变，那是不是说明打浆对氢键网络基本没影响？
reference.reference_answer: 不表示完全不变。本文三类氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此据公式推得能量和距离基本不变；但相对含量仍变化：0到16000转，针叶木分子间氢键由28.23%变为23.56%，阔叶木由26.55%变为24.98%。应区分单类氢键能量/距离与不同组分的相对分布。

candidate.answer:
**阔叶木（hardwood）O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键的相对含量随 PFI 磨浆转数的变化**（数值来自表 2b 的分峰面积占比，并非绝对含量 [2]）

- 4000 转：33.06%
- 8000 转：29.81%
- 12,000 转：29.28%
（表 2b [2]）

- 4000→12,000 转的绝对变化：33.06% → 29.28%，即**下降 3.78 个百分点**（这是按表 2b 数值计算 [2]，并非原文引文）
- 相对变化：以 4000 转为基准，**相对下降约 11.4%**（−3.78/33.06，计算值 [2]）

关于变化过程和不确定性：
- 在这一区间内，相对含量并非单调下降。4000→8000 转下降了 3.25 个百分点，8000→12,000 转仅再下降 0.53 个百分点，因此 12,000 转低于 8000 转 [2]。
- 论文没有给出这些占比的误差范围或显著性检验；表中仅报告非线性拟合的 r²：4000 转为 0.9991、8000 转为 0.9991、12,000 转为 0.9992 [2]。分峰拟合的质量好，并不代表两次测量之间的差异在统计上显著。
- 就全过程的趋势（0→16,000 转）而言，阔叶木该氢键总体上升（29.09%→31.65%），作者据此报告阔叶木“总体增加 8.8%”，并称其变化趋势与针叶木（softwood）相似（针叶木总体增加 22.78%）[1][2]。也就是说，如果把 4000 转当作参照点，得出的下降与该文献描述的“先增后减再增”整体趋势并不矛盾，只是局部波动 [1][2]。
- 上述“相对含量”是 3000–3700 cm⁻¹ 羟基谱带解卷积后各分峰的面积占比 [2]，不是氢键数量或能量的直接测量；作者对氢键能量和距离的结论是它们在磨浆过程中基本不变 [1]。

针叶木（softwood fibers）在 PFI 打浆 16,000 r 时，两项结晶度指数和两种氢键相对含量的数值汇总如下；这些数值都是该打浆转数下直接测得的，而不是相对于初始值的累积变化量：

| 指标 | 16,000 r 数值 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| CI-XI（由 XRD 衍射峰强度之比得到的结晶度指数） | 69.82% | 表 1(a) 中针叶木 16,000 r 对应行 [3] |
| CI-XA（由 XRD 衍射峰面积之比得到的结晶度指数） | 34.20% | 表 1(a) [3] |
| O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量 | 23.56% | 表 2(a) [5] |
| O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键相对含量 | 34.92% | 表 2(a) [5] |

需要补充说明的事项：

- 表 2(a) 同一行还列有 O(2)H···O(6) 为 29.38%、游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 为 12.14%，拟合 r² 为 0.9996；四项合计正好为 100.00%（23.56+34.92+29.38+12.14），这些数值是按羟基谱带各组分的峰面积占比归一化得到的 [5]。表中的 r² 是谱带解卷积拟合的优度，并不表示测量不确定度；表格没有给出重复实验的标准差或误差范围，因此各数值的测量不确定度无法从所给证据中获得。
- CI-XI 明显高于 CI-XA，作者把这一点归因于“可能是因为 CI-XA 分析中无定形贡献被过拟合”（原文用 might be caused by，属于作者给出的推测性解释），因此不应把 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 视为可互换使用的量 [3]。这一“不可互换”的说法是基于上述解释作出的推断。
- 两类数值来自不同方法：CI 来自 XRD 峰强度之比或峰面积之比 [3]；氢键相对含量来自 FT-IR 3000–3700 cm⁻¹ 羟基谱带解卷积后按面积占比计算 [4]。因此“相对含量”指的是各组分在羟基谱带中的占比，而不是绝对氢键数量。
- 就本组数据来看，16,000 r 时针叶木 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量为 0–16,000 r 各阶段中的最低值（从 0 r 的 28.23% 降到 23.56%），O(3)H···O(5) 为最高值（从 28.44% 升到 34.92%）[5]。
- 原文称 O(3)H···O(5) 较为稳定，“推测其在 PFI 打浆中随结晶度变化很小”，因而未讨论它与 CI-XI 的相关性 [1]；但同一文的 Table 2(a) 数据显示，该氢键相对含量总体上升了 22.78% [4]，这与上述“变化很小”的推测之间存在张力，引用时宜区分“作者推测”与“实测变化”。
- 原文给出 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.912（p<0.05，针叶木）[1]；这只是相关性，不能据此推断因果关系，也不能据此把 CI-XI 当作氢键含量的预测指标。

[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.

claims.text:
针叶木（softwood fibers）在 PFI 打浆 16,000 r 时，两项结晶度指数和两种氢键相对含量的数值汇总如下；这些数值都是该打浆转数下直接测得的，而不是相对于初始值的累积变化量：

| 指标 | 16,000 r 数值 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| CI-XI（由 XRD 衍射峰强度之比得到的结晶度指数） | 69.82% | 表 1(a) 中针叶木 16,000 r 对应行 [3] |
| CI-XA（由 XRD 衍射峰面积之比得到的结晶度指数） | 34.20% | 表 1(a) [3] |
| O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量 | 23.56% | 表 2(a) [5] |
| O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键相对含量 | 34.92% | 表 2(a) [5] |

需要补充说明的事项：

- 表 2(a) 同一行还列有 O(2)H···O(6) 为 29.38%、游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 为 12.14%，拟合 r² 为 0.9996；四项合计正好为 100.00%（23.56+34.92+29.38+12.14），这些数值是按羟基谱带各组分的峰面积占比归一化得到的 [5]。表中的 r² 是谱带解卷积拟合的优度，并不表示测量不确定度；表格没有给出重复实验的标准差或误差范围，因此各数值的测量不确定度无法从所给证据中获得。
- CI-XI 明显高于 CI-XA，作者把这一点归因于“可能是因为 CI-XA 分析中无定形贡献被过拟合”（原文用 might be caused by，属于作者给出的推测性解释），因此不应把 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 视为可互换使用的量 [3]。这一“不可互换”的说法是基于上述解释作出的推断。
- 两类数值来自不同方法：CI 来自 XRD 峰强度之比或峰面积之比 [3]；氢键相对含量来自 FT-IR 3000–3700 cm⁻¹ 羟基谱带解卷积后按面积占比计算 [4]。因此“相对含量”指的是各组分在羟基谱带中的占比，而不是绝对氢键数量。
- 就本组数据来看，16,000 r 时针叶木 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量为 0–16,000 r 各阶段中的最低值（从 0 r 的 28.23% 降到 23.56%），O(3)H···O(5) 为最高值（从 28.44% 升到 34.92%）[5]。
- 原文称 O(3)H···O(5) 较为稳定，“推测其在 PFI 打浆中随结晶度变化很小”，因而未讨论它与 CI-XI 的相关性 [1]；但同一文的 Table 2(a) 数据显示，该氢键相对含量总体上升了 22.78% [4]，这与上述“变化很小”的推测之间存在张力，引用时宜区分“作者推测”与“实测变化”。
- 原文给出 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.912（p<0.05，针叶木）[1]；这只是相关性，不能据此推断因果关系，也不能据此把 CI-XI 当作氢键含量的预测指标。

需要保留并补充的限制：

1. **同一论文内部数值不一致。** 正文 3.4 节报告针叶木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889（均 p < 0.05）[1]；摘要则报告针叶木 **0.888**、阔叶木 0.889（均 p < 0.05）[2]。针叶木两处数值不一致，所给证据无法判断原因或哪一个应作为最终值；应并列披露，不能无说明地只取 0.912，也不能断言“以正文为准”。结论部分只称二者存在显著正相关[3]，未给出具体系数。

Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

[原文]
Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

需要保留并补充的限制：

1. **同一论文内部数值不一致。** 正文 3.4 节报告针叶木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889（均 p < 0.05）[1]；摘要则报告针叶木 **0.888**、阔叶木 0.889（均 p < 0.05）[2]。针叶木两处数值不一致，所给证据无法判断原因或哪一个应作为最终值；应并列披露，不能无说明地只取 0.912，也不能断言“以正文为准”。结论部分只称二者存在显著正相关[3]，未给出具体系数。

2. **趋势解释是作者提出的可能机制，不是因果证明。** 作者认为结晶区的 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量可能高于无定形区，因而氢键相对含量与 CI-XI 呈相似变化[1]。这只是基于示意图/文献的可能解释；相关性本身不能推出因果关系。

3. **不确定性和适用范围。** 表中可见 0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r 五个磨浆水平：O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量依次为 28.23%、26.05%、28.43%、26.68%、23.56%，CI-XI 依次为 73.23%、70.42%、72.54%、70.93%、69.82%[4][5]。但原文未说明 Pearson 分析的样本量/重复数、置信区间或相关系数的不确定性，因此不能断言“仅基于 5 个点”或“不确定性较高”，也不宜外推到其他原料或处理条件。

candidate.answer:
## 一、PFI 打浆使纸变结实的逐步过程

**第 1 步：机械作用同时产生四种效应**（该文对 PFI 打浆的归纳）[11]：
1. **内细纤维化**——纤维壁分层、疏松并润胀；
2. **外细纤维化**——表面微纤丝被剥离但仍附着于纤维；
3. **纤维切断**——剪切作用使纤维变短；
4. **细小纤维生成**——初生细小纤维来自射线细胞与薄壁细胞，另一部分由纤维切断或外细纤维化产生[11]。

**第 2 步：形态与润胀指标随之改变。** 随 PFI 转数增加（该文测试到 16,000 r），**软木浆**的宏细纤维化指数与纤维长度显著下降、细小纤维含量上升；**硬木浆**的宏细纤维化指数与纤维长度相对软木浆**无显著变化**，作者归因于硬木所用打浆压力较低[1]（细小纤维的上升趋势原文只针对软木浆陈述[1]）。同时**打浆度和 WRV 随转数显著上升**，原因是细纤维化产生了新表面与更多孔隙[6]。

**第 3 步：润胀使纤维更柔顺，从而改善纤维间结合。** WRV 所表征的润胀使纤维**横向更柔顺**，因而**有助于改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度**[6]。分子层面：PFI 未改变氢键能量与距离（峰位几乎无红移/蓝移），但改变了各类氢键的相对含量——分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键总量软木降 16.54%、硬木降 5.91%；分子间氢键减少与结晶度下降共同提高分子链活动性、可及性与 WRV，即提高纤维柔顺性[2][9]。需注意作者同时强调：总体而言晶粒尺寸、结晶度与各类氢键含量“变化不大”，PFI 是细纤维化效果好、对超分子结构破坏较小的机械处理[12]。

**第 4 步：强度上升，而非纤维本身变强。** 零-span 抗张指数显示 **PFI 未降低纤维自身强度**；作者总结 PFI 提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内细纤维化）、纤维润胀与纸页抗张强度，而纤维抗张强度不下降[10]。即增益主要来自**网络结合**（结合面积与柔顺性），不是单根纤维强度[10][12]。

## 二、纤维长度、细小纤维、WRV：谁贡献最大

**现有证据只支持定性分工，不支持给出贡献排名。**

- 原文最接近“主因”的表述是：**抗张强度的提升主要归因于 PFI 过程中的细纤维化和细小纤维**——二者并列，未在两者之间排序，也未把 WRV 纳入该判断[10]。
- **WRV** 在文中是**中介变量**：打浆→细纤维化/新表面→润胀（WRV↑）→横向柔顺→纤维间结合↑[6]。这是机理解释，该文并未检验 WRV 对强度的独立贡献。
- **纤维长度**的作用**因指标而异**：对**湿纸幅强度**，作者明确指出纤维长度起关键作用，并以此解释软木（纤维更长）湿纸幅强度增幅大于硬木；但同一打浆过程中软木纤维长度是**下降**的[1][10]。因此不能简单说“长度越大贡献越大”，需区分湿纸幅强度与干抗张强度、以及被打浆削短后的净效应。

**明确缺口：** 该文献未做偏相关、回归或方差分解，未报告纤维长度、细小纤维含量、WRV 对干抗张指数的标准化系数或贡献率；文中 p<0.05 的相关性只出现在结晶度指标之间（软木 r=0.919、硬木 r=0.925）[5]，与强度归因无关。故“哪个贡献最大”**无法定量回答**。就方向性而言，只能引用作者的定性判断：**细纤维化与细小纤维是抗张强度提升的主要因素 [10]，WRV 通过润胀/柔顺性起中介作用 [6]，纤维长度主要影响湿纸幅强度 [10]**——这不等同于三者的贡献排序。相关图（Figure 1–3、6–7、Table 1–2）的数值未逐点核读，上述结论均取自原文文字与表格。
